newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end higher, seen firm next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end higher, seen firm next week.

text.p: Helped by a rebound on Wall Wall Street, Brazil shares ended firm on Friday, with bellwether Telebras stocks and options dominating trade, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most active stocks closed up 1.99 percent at 9,499 points. Market turnover totalled 613.9 million reais ($556.8 million).
Some analysts said they were surprised with the market's sharp rally so far this year but they noted that the bolsa is showing no sign that it will weaken.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index, comprising the nine most liquid stocks of the electrical sector, ended up 0.44 percent at 2,611 points.
"It appears that the bolsa will keep climbing next week despite a 35 percent increase in share prices since the beginning of the year," a senior trader said.
Telebras preferred, which accounts for over 60 percent of daily trade on average, rose 2.88 percent to 115 reais.
State oil firm Petrobras gained 1.64 percent, closing at 216.50 reais, while mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) rose 2.32 percent to 26.50 reais.
